scripts.gen:api-types: npm run gen:api-types:pipeline && npm run gen:api-types:auditor
scripts.snapshot:api:pipeline: curl -fsS ${PIPELINE_OPENAPI:-http://127.0.0.1:8766/openapi.json} | python3 -c "import json,sys; json.dump(json.load(sys.stdin), open('src/types/generated/pipeline.openapi.json','w'), indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False); open('src/types/generated/pipeline.openapi.json','a').write('\n')"
scripts.snapshot:api:auditor: curl -fsS ${AUDITOR_OPENAPI:-http://127.0.0.1:8765/openapi.json} | python3 -c "import json,sys; json.dump(json.load(sys.stdin), open('src/types/generated/auditor.openapi.json','w'), indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False); open('src/types/generated/auditor.openapi.json','a').write('\n')"
scripts.snapshot:api: npm run snapshot:api:pipeline && npm run snapshot:api:auditor
